root_cause: The novice outcome-first Modelwijzer added 99 public Dutch strings after the previous Modelwijzer static-English cache recovery.
The feature content and governance checks could pass while deterministic production localization still failed because exact source-string coverage was incomplete.
prevention: Every visible novice Modelwijzer label, help text, option, CTA and accessibility string receives an exact deterministic English cache entry in the same lineage.
Final post-shell production build parity is required with STATIC_I18N_NETWORK=0 and STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE=1.
Do not weaken the fail-closed i18n gate to ship Modelwijzer features.
A later Modelwijzer copy change reopens the same i18n obligation before production promotion.
